description: This file defines the 'ShardedMessageEnvelope' class, which encapsulates message envelopes used in a distributed messaging system, specifically for persistence actors. It manages message identifiers, message types, message content, and associated headers, and provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and accessors.

classes.name: ShardedMessageEnvelope
classes.description: A message envelope for messages to PersistenceActors, holding ID, type, message content, and headers. Implements JSON serialization/deserialization and header management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ShardedMessageEnvelope with specified id, type, message, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonObject into a ShardedMessageEnvelope instance.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the envelope.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the envelope to a JsonObject.
